mapper.sql: id, venue_id, venue_name_snapshot, name, threshold_amount, discount_amount, total_stock, remaining_stock, claim_start_at, claim_end_at, valid_from, valid_until, status, cache_ready, preheated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into coupon_activity (venue_id, venue_name_snapshot, name, threshold_amount, discount_amount, total_stock, remaining_stock, claim_start_at, claim_end_at, valid_from, valid_until, status, cache_ready, created_by) values (#{venueId}, #{venueNameSnapshot}, #{name}, #{thresholdAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{totalStock}, #{remainingStock}, #{claimStartAt}, #{claimEndAt}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, #{status}, #{cacheReady}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update coupon_activity set name = #{name}, threshold_amount = #{thresholdAmount}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, remaining_stock = #{remainingStock}, claim_start_at = #{claimStartAt}, claim_end_at = #{claimEndAt}, valid_from = #{validFrom}, valid_until = #{validUntil}, cache_ready = 0, preheated_at = null where id = #{id} and venue_id = #{venueId} and status = 'DRAFT'
update coupon_activity set status = 'ENDED', cache_ready = 0, preheated_at = null where status = 'PUBLISHED' and claim_end_at <= #{now}
mapper.select: select ca.id, ca.venue_id, ca.name, ca.threshold_amount, ca.discount_amount, ca.claim_start_at, ca.claim_end_at, ca.valid_from, ca.valid_until, case when ca.remaining_stock = 0 then 'SOLD_OUT' when ca.claim_start_at > #{now} then 'NOT_STARTED' else 'IN_PROGRESS' end as claim_state from coupon_activity ca where ca.venue_id = #{venueId} and ca.status = 'PUBLISHED' and ca.claim_end_at > #{now} order by ca.claim_start_at, ca.id
mapper.update: update user_coupon set status = 'EXPIRED' where status = 'AVAILABLE' and valid_until <= #{now}
update user_coupon set status = 'USED', used_at = #{now}, used_order_id = #{orderId}, locked_order_id = null where id = #{couponId} and status = 'LOCKED' and locked_order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: select id, activity_id, user_id, venue_id, coupon_name, threshold_amount, discount_amount, valid_from, valid_until, status, acquired_at, used_at, locked_order_id, used_order_id, created_at, updated_at from user_coupon where id = #{couponId}
mapper.insert: insert into coupon_order_reservation (order_id, coupon_id, status) values (#{orderId}, #{couponId}, #{status})
mapper.update: update user_coupon set status = case when valid_until > #{now} then 'AVAILABLE' else 'EXPIRED' end, locked_order_id = null where status = 'LOCKED' and updated_at < #{lockedBefore}
mapper.select: select id, venue_id, venue_name_snapshot, name, threshold_amount, discount_amount, total_stock, remaining_stock, claim_start_at, claim_end_at, valid_from, valid_until, status, cache_ready, preheated_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at from coupon_activity where status = 'PUBLISHED' and cache_ready = 0 and remaining_stock > 0 and claim_start_at <= #{preheatDeadline} and claim_end_at > #{now} order by claim_start_at, id
